cases.statement: The retainRaw function takes age in days and must return true through age 30 days inclusive and false for greater ages.
cases.main:
const HOURS_PER_DAY = 24;
export function retainRaw(ageDays) { return ageDays <= 30 * HOURS_PER_DAY; }
